## Reviewer checklist
- [ ] Parity: passed/total before and after
- [ ] Gaps logged for everything that went wrong or was worked around (ids)
- [ ] `/find-existing` was done: nothing duplicated (reuse, extend or new, and why)
- [ ] `neojac arch --text` is clean; layers unchanged or the change is explained
- [ ] Every new module has a one-line docstring and a clear single purpose
